description: This file defines a React functional component 'PreviewComponent' responsible for rendering previews of various file types (images, videos, audio, text, or fallback object) based on the file's MIME type and attributes. It handles native platform previews, creates object URLs, and manages related side effects.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the properties accepted by the PreviewComponent, including references to application, file, bytes, and display options.

methods.name: PreviewComponent
methods.description: React functional component rendering different previews based on file type, including handling native preview cases and managing object URLs.
